about.desc: Hello, I'm Adit. The programming world first caught my attention due to curiosity about how applications help people complete their tasks. Since then, I've delved into web and desktop development. Over my 2+ years working as a developer, I've been involved in developing various enterprise application systems, from feature design and module creation to implementation and maintenance. I believe every line of code written should have a purpose: to make work faster, easier, and more beneficial.
